CI at head `1ea01963`: 29 success, 18 skipped, 2 failure: `Test UI (1/16)` and its aggregate `Test UI`. Every other check is green.

The one failing test is `packages/app-shell/src/sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts` › "every bare cookie-only call is a counted row of the shrink-only allow-list": `Error: Test timed out in 15000ms` (15202 ms; job 140828751977). Its three sibling cases in the same file passed. Shard totals: `Test Files 1 failed | 357 passed (358)`, `Tests 1 failed | 7386 passed | 1 skipped`.

I judge this failure as not caused by this PR:
- The case parses every non-test `.ts`/`.tsx` under `ui/packages/*/src` and `ui/apps/console/src` (`scan()`). This PR changes one file, `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`, which is outside that population, and it changes nothing the scan imports.
- Locally at this head the same file passes: `Tests 4 passed (4)`, with that case at 5215 ms (`vitest run --project unit packages/app-shell/src/sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts`). So the 15 s timeout tripped from shard load on a whole-tree AST scan. The assertion itself did not fail.

The seat decides on a re-run, since a dev doesn't re-run. The case runs about 5 s alone and 15 s on a CI shard, so it sits at the timeout edge. That goes to the seat as an out-of-scope finding, and this PR doesn't change it.

- Ablation in the body (the manifest pointed at a byte-identical copy elsewhere) reds the pin, so the realpath pin is not vacuous.
